sceneDescription: Ikigo cyerekana iyi mushakisha ya Helia node. Icyatsi kibisi kibisi cyahujwe na mushakisha kandi gifite umurongo ugana hagati. Violet node yavumbuwe na mushakisha ikoresha ariko ntabwo ihujwe. Inzahabu zahabu zifunguye zavuzwe na Kubo daemon yihariye; ntabwo ari mushakisha ihuza kandi nta murongo ugana iki kigo. Slate yapfuye inyenyeri zibika amateka adahuye, kandi umurongo wibimenyetso byavanyweho nyuma yo gutandukana. Intera n'amakarita yo hagati yapimye ubukererwe; urungano rutapimwe rufata orbit yo hanze, hamwe nitsinda ryinguni byagaragaye ubwikorezi. Imitako yimbere yinyenyeri ntabwo ihagarariye urungano. Inzira yoroheje yo hanze iranga Kubo yatumijwe hanze kandi ntabwo ihuza. Impande ya relay igaragara gusa mugihe indangamuntu ya relay ihari murungano rwiteganijwe; urungano rwurungano rwurungano rwarwo ntirwigeze rusuzumwa. Koresha urungano rwumushakashatsi kumakuru amwe muburyo bwinyandiko.
fallbackBody: Iki gikoresho ntigishobora gukora imiterere ya WebGL itekanye. Live Helia kwitegereza bikomeza kuboneka binyuze murungano.
